en: Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing two Indigenous men wearing patterned ponchos and traditional sandals, posed in a studio setting. One man is standing beside a large decorated clay vessel; the other is squatting. The background is a painted backdrop depicting a European-style villa or small palace with turrets, balconies, stairs, and a landscaped garden. The image has wide margins consistent with early 20th‑century postcards.
